description: Search Dealroom companies by keyword and/or tier, sector and country: name, tier, sector, HQ, founding year, numeric valuation and range, logo and link. At least one of keyword / tier / sector / country is required. The keyword matches company names: pass a name or a short term, up to 48 characters (accented and non-Latin letters count as 2–3), and use tier, sector and country to narrow the search. 1 point per returned record.

keyword.description: Keyword. e.g. revolut. Up to 48 characters

sector.description: Sector. Options: Fintech = Fintech, Biotech & Life Sciences = Biotech & Life Sciences, eCommerce & Marketplaces = eCommerce & Marketplaces, Health Tech & Medtech = Health Tech & Medtech, Other B2B Software = Other B2B Software, Energy = Energy, Consumer Services = Consumer Services, Transportation = Transportation, Marketing = Marketing, AI = AI, Cybersecurity = Cybersecurity, Food = Food, Semiconductors = Semiconductors, Edtech = Edtech, Robotics = Robotics, Space = Space, Defence = Defence, Aviation = Aviation

sort.description: Sort by. Options: valuation = Valuation, alphabetical = Alphabetical, founded = Founding year

tier.description: Tier. Options: Centicorn = Centicorn, Colt = Colt, Decacorn = Decacorn, Gigacorn = Gigacorn, Listed = Listed, Mag 7 = Mag 7, Thoroughbred = Thoroughbred, Titan = Titan, Unicorn = Unicorn

name: run_dealroom_companies_search
title: Dealroom companies search
